name: psd3-readiness-consent-vop
title: PSD3 Readiness, Consent Stress and VoP Match Rate
description: Three independent computations over an open-banking payment-initiation surface. Step 1 scores the six-domain PSD3 and PSR readiness rubric and produces a prioritised gap table (art-14). Step 2 stresses the consent-lifecycle state machine by Monte Carlo and checks the ASPSP availability threshold (sim-07). Step 3 analyses batch payee name-match rates at the declared strictness (art-11). Each step computes from its own declared inputs; the order is analytical. The graph dates PSD3 readiness at 2027-06-01.

steps.handoff: Six-domain PSD3 and PSR readiness scores with a prioritised gap table. Stage 1 of 3.
Consent-lifecycle terminal-state distribution and the ASPSP availability compliance check. Stage 2 of 3.
Batch match, close-match and no-match counts with the resulting match rate at the declared strictness. Final stage.
